label: Italian municipal property tax (IMU)
name: Name
year: Tax year of the confirmed amounts
notice: Use your municipality or tax adviser's confirmed IMU computation for your taxable property and ownership share.
balanceHelp: Enter the amount still due in December. Enter zero if the full amount is paid in June.
repeatHelp: Enter zero for only the confirmed tax year. To forecast the same euro amounts, enter the final year.
invalidYears: Choose a repeat-through year at least as late as the confirmed tax year, or enter zero.
